answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Train driver route knowledge certificate with operator attestation. It requires each certificate is a route learned and examined by the train operator, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real drivers, so the jade of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The kernel is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The quill is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
